newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds follow Chicago higher, trade slow.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds follow Chicago higher, trade slow.

text.p: UK meals and feeds sellers marked up high protein soymeal by around 1.50 stg a tonne on Friday following gains in Chicago at Thursday's close.
Trade was very quiet with only one deal reported when spot high protein soymeal fetched 215 stg a tonne ex-store on the south coast.
"I wouldn't get too excited about this one becuase I think it's for all of five tonnes, which when you think about just about sums up the state of the market at the moment," said a trader.
